title: feat(landing): integrations hub at /integrations, Supabase and Railway docs

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge Marketing pages only: links are pinned by a new test and I confirmed locale prefixing, message parity and the `.md` twin route; the one note is inventory duplication. 1 note · tests covered · risk low Adds an integrations hub at `/integrations` (en, ja, ko) with a client-side search, plus Supabase and Railway docs and their dashboard `docsUrl` entries. Safe to merge. The open `failed_to_load_clerk_js` error in `NavBar.tsx` is untouched: the diff only adds a menu link there. - `integrations-hub.ts` holds every tile; `IntegrationsHub.astro` renders it for `/integrations`, `/ja` and `/ko` - Supabase and Railway pages added and wired into the dashboard catalog's `docsUrl` - `/integrations.md` twin, an `llms.txt` section, and nav/breadcrumb links to the hub - Search and rail highlighting filter tiles client-side off `data-search` ### Findings
🔵 Note · F1 · Hub re-lists docs pages that GUIDE_SECTIONS already owns maintainability · [`apps/landing/src/lib/integrations-hub.ts:45-123`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/5144f46f072e79109c795789e604ea1f7a6a1630/apps/landing/src/lib/integrations-hub.ts#L45-L123) The language, cloud, database and code tiles repeat doc hrefs that `GUIDE_SECTIONS` in `apps/landing/src/lib/instrumentation-guides.ts` already carries for `/docs/instrumentation` — Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, Laravel, Browser, Kubernetes, Docker, Prometheus, PlanetScale, WarpStream, GitHub. Adding a guide to one list leaves the other stale, and the hub is presented as the complete inventory; the agents category shows the pattern that avoids it, importing `AGENT_FRAMEWORK_GUIDES` instead of copying it. ``` Build these tiles from `GUIDE_SECTIONS`/`LANGUAGE_IDS` where the target doc is the same, or add a case to `integrations-hub.test.ts` asserting every `GUIDE_SECTIONS` card href appears among the hub tiles so the two lists cannot drift. ```
### Production impact
Open errors in the changed files | Issue | Service | Occurrences | File | | --- | --- | ---: | --- | | failed_to_load_clerk_js | maple-landing | 6 | `apps/landing/src/components/NavBar.tsx` | After this merges, Maple checks whether they stop.
What was checked - `Breadcrumb.astro:18` locale-prefixes item hrefs, so `/integrations` trails resolve to `/ja/...` and `/ko/...` - All 52 new message keys exist in en, ja and ko, and every `m.*` the hub calls is defined - `both("Integrations", "/integrations")` in `llms.txt.ts:86` resolves to the new `integrations.md.ts` route
`5144f46` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.
